title: 1317. Convert Integer to the Sum of Two No-Zero Integers

examples.explanation: Let a = 1 and b = 1. Both a and b are no-zero integers, and a + b = 2 = n.
Let a = 2 and b = 9. Both a and b are no-zero integers, and a + b = 11 = n. Note that there are other valid answers as [8, 3] that can be accepted.
